speaker: Sheldon
text: Mommy? Hi, baby. Just a blue. How nice. Honey, why'd you get Lou?

speaker: Leonard
text: This is a particularly disturbing one. Thank you.

speaker: Leonard
text: I was working with luminous fish, and I thought, hey, Lou.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Mom, what are you doing here? I know, but why?

speaker: Leonard
text: Because one of the great minds of the 21st century is raising glow-in-the-dark fish and weaving serapes.

speaker: Sheldon
text: This is not a serape. This is a poncho. A serape is open at the sides. A poncho is closed. This is a poncho. And neither is a reason to call someone's mother.

speaker: Leonard
text: Really? When was the last time you left the house?

speaker: Sheldon
text: I went to the market with Penny.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Wait, then buckle up. In the next four to eight days, she's going to get very crabby.
